model_annotation: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “per-specialty terms” across medical specialties, showing a baseline model and multiple fine-tuned variants as grouped bars for each specialty category. The horizontal axis contains the categories (left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, an Obstetrics group label that is partially obscured by a white overlay, and Pediatrics) and is labeled “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Negative log probability,” displayed on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately −22, −23, −24, −25, −26, and −27 (regularly spaced by 1 unit), and the plotted values fall roughly within −22 to −27. For each specialty category, seven narrow vertical bars are arranged side-by-side: a light blue bar for “Mistralv0.2-Base,” followed by six warm-colored bars corresponding to “Fine-tuned on” specialties (very light beige for Cardio, light peach for Gastro, light orange for Infect, orange for Neuro, medium brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics). In the Cardio category, the blue baseline bar reaches about −26.7, while the fine-tuned bars are clustered around roughly −25.7 to −26.1 (darkest brown near −26.1). In Gastro, the blue baseline is near −24.8 and the fine-tuned bars lie around about −24.0 to −24.2. In Infect, the blue baseline is around −23.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around approximately −22.9 to −23.2 (with the darkest brown near −23.2). In Neuro, the blue baseline is near −25.4 and the fine-tuned bars span about −24.2 to −24.6 (darkest brown near −24.6). In the partially obscured Obstetrics group, the blue baseline is near −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around roughly −23.8 to −24.0. In Pediatrics, the blue baseline is again near −24.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around approximately −23.5 to −24.0 (darkest brown near −24.0). The bars are not presented as sorted by magnitude; instead, they follow a consistent left-to-right order within each group based on the legend, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color coding.
